report.answer_text:
Men's singles: Jannik Sinner won. He beat two-time defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in the final, 4–6, 6–4, 6–4, 6–4.[1] He became the first Italian to win a Wimbledon singles title.[1]
Women's singles: Iga Swiatek won. She beat Amanda Anisimova to become Poland's first Wimbledon singles champion.[2]
The tournament ran from June 30 to July 13, 2025.[2]
